Patriotism asks you to fight for values and an ideal. 

Nationalism asks you to fight for a person or group. 

There's a difference, and it matters.

posts.text:
My grandfather gave me one last gift before he passed away: a Bible.

Inside, he wrote four words: "Have faith, not fear."

Fear is the accelerant of nationalism. Faith is the foundation of patriotism.

Let’s choose faith.

posts.text:
On America’s 250th birthday, we remember what true patriotism is about: Service, sacrifice, and working together to protect what it means to be an American.

Today, we celebrate our history while continuing to define our future. We owe it to ourselves, our children, and everyone who will continue to hold the torch.
